checks: program byte hash and canonical hash
all logical and executed instruction counts from independent AST walk
all component access totals from independent AST walk
energy and cycle component sums and display conversions
independent per-port tape-stage energy and cycles
complete tape input/output counts and per-port layout
allocated and initialized scratch totals and capacity
limitations: This lightweight audit does not recompute full per-address scratch energy or placement. The full shared scorer does those computations; cached/uncached comparisons and separate expanded-event tests validate the scorer.
This audit does not establish numerical accuracy.
